newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end short day narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end short day narrowly mixed.

text.p: Nov 27 - U.S. debt futures ended an abbreviated trading session narrowly mixed. T-bonds closed at 1210 CST/1810 GMT. Trade in Euros ended at 1200 CST/1800 GMT. Dec T-bonds continued to grind lower, falling near key support at 115-02/32 in the final minutes of pit trade. -Derivatives desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
